svg.title: Token Usage Dashboard Mobile — telemetry
svg.desc: Mobile token usage telemetry: 74.9B tokens, 94.2% cache hit, $64,465.67 estimated cost, peak 2.9B on 05-21. Pure SVG SMIL animation.
